primary.description: UK adults paid on a regular date who mentally subtract bills from the balance shown by their bank.
primary.jobToBeDone: See what is likely to remain after costs due before payday.
primary.tension: The bank balance looks available even though several payments have not left yet.
useCases: checking a one-off cost before payday

primary.description: People who want a useful cash-position calculation without connecting a bank account.
primary.jobToBeDone: Keep direct control of the figures used in the calculation.
primary.tension: They do not want to share bank-login or Open Banking data with a planning tool.

primary.description: Households whose short-term position changes because of irregular or one-off costs.
primary.jobToBeDone: Include costs that a static monthly budget can miss.
primary.tension: A repair, school cost or annual renewal can materially change what remains this pay cycle.

secondary.description: People planning to the next income date they can reasonably rely on.
secondary.caution: Content must not imply business cash-flow, tax or income advice.

secondary.description: People who understand the arithmetic but want a position they can save and update.
secondary.caution: Do not claim spreadsheets are inherently inaccurate or unsuitable.

excludedTargeting: People seeking a debt-management or insolvency solution
Businesses seeking accounting or treasury software
